# withWatermark

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Adds a text watermark. With no `opacity`/`rotationDegrees` the defaults apply (gray, 15% opacity, -45 degree rotation, 72pt).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
withWatermark(settings: DocumentSettings, text: string): DocumentSettings
withWatermark(settings: DocumentSettings, text: string, opacity: number, rotationDegrees: number): DocumentSettings
```
